answer: Use a slow vesting path for new identities. Each locks 40 POA for 30 days and gains weight in steps, like a mesa in three tiers: no weight until day 10, half after two audits, full only after day 30 with no missed checks. Each week it must complete sparrow tasks, small verified jobs seeded from the nebula of block hashes. One person pays once; a farm pays per identity, so 100 fakes tie up 4,000 POA for a month, and any missed week restarts that identity's clock. Auditors re-verify the lock, task outputs, and timestamps on-ledger; fabricated outputs slash 30% and reset the tier.
